summary: Mathieux Davis (born December 15, 1997) is an American drummer, social media influencer, and biomedical engineer based in the Atlanta, Georgia metro area (Flowery Branch). He is NOT a traditional band but a solo artist and session/touring drummer. He rose to fame through viral 'church metal drummer' skits and drum covers on social media starting in 2017, accelerating during COVID-19 in 2020. He has amassed nearly 900,000 followers across platforms. He is known for fusing gospel music with metal/hard rock. He currently drums for New Zealand metal artist Vana (toured internationally, including opening for Linkin Park in New Zealand arenas in March 2025) and has performed with country artist Reyna Roberts. He holds artist endorsements from Ludwig Drums, Zildjian Cymbals, Vic Firth drumsticks, and Conn Selmer. He graduated from Mississippi State University with a Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering.
